{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out the -1 values in customer_age (sentinel for missing age)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
